description: This file defines data models, model registration, and a GenericModel class for interacting with API endpoints in a Vue.js project. It includes model configurations, import statements, and utility functions for CRUD operations.

classes.name: GenericModel
classes.description: A class providing standardized CRUD and utility operations for models interacting with API endpoints.

methods.name: getTableHeaders
methods.description: Returns table headers with localized titles for the model.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Queries the list endpoint for the model with given parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new model instance via API.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing model instance via API.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a specific model instance by ID.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes a specific model instance by ID.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges one model instance into another, updating references and deleting the source.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Changes the parent of a tree-structured model instance.

methods.name: getDeleteProtecting
methods.description: Fetches the list of protected relations for deletion.

methods.name: getDeleteCascading
methods.description: Fetches the list of cascading delete relations.

methods.name: getDeleteNulling
methods.description: Fetches the list of nulling delete relations.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Generates a label string for a model instance based on toStringKeys.
